errors.description: The squared-off collar point termination that defines this option is still not rendered. The collar remains, in substance, a conventional point collar. The viewer's-left leaf shows at most a marginal blunting of the tip; the viewer's-right leaf still converges to a clearly acute apex.
errors.expected: Both collar leaves terminate in an unmistakable flat, straight, squared-off edge roughly 1 cm wide, perpendicular to the collar's front edge, producing two crisp right-angle corners on each leaf (four across the collar) — a termination readable as 'square' within one second, as it plainly is in the blueprint.
errors.actual: The viewer's-right leaf tapers to a sharp acute point with no flat terminal edge and no square corners. The viewer's-left leaf is only slightly truncated — a tiny blunted nub, far short of the pronounced flat cut in the blueprint. A customer could not distinguish this image from a standard point collar.
errors.correction: The squared termination must be made geometrically explicit and identical on both leaves: end each leaf with a flat cut of real, visible width, not a softened or truncated point. Consider describing the leaf as a quadrilateral whose lower end is a straight horizontal edge, and explicitly stating that the collar tip has WIDTH rather than converging.

errors.description: The two collar leaves are not treated consistently: their tip geometry differs from each other.
errors.expected: Both collar leaves mirror one another exactly, each ending in the same squared, flat termination of the same width and corner angle.
errors.actual: The viewer's-left tip is slightly blunted while the viewer's-right tip is a sharp acute point; the two leaves read as different collar styles within the same photograph.
errors.correction: Require explicit mirror symmetry: both leaves identical in length, taper and squared terminal edge width.

errors.description: The collar band remains largely obscured behind the neck.
errors.expected: The collar stand's height and topstitched upper edge readable alongside the points, as shown in the blueprint.
errors.actual: Only a narrow sliver of the band is visible near the front closure; its height and top edge cannot be assessed.
errors.correction: Raise the camera slightly and rotate marginally so the stand reads clearly.
